pages.md: Hi {name}! I'm Mauro, one of the maintainers of Kairos, and this is KAI, our armadillo mascot. In this workshop you build and run an immutable Kubernetes cluster, one stage at a time. You type every command yourself, because that is how it sticks. KAI helps when you get stuck.
An immutable system treats the operating system like an application image. You never patch it in place. You build a new image, boot into it, and go back to the previous one if it misbehaves.
Why? Upgrades are predictable, rollbacks are instant, and every machine is identical, so nothing drifts.

Kairos is a fully open source CNCF Sandbox project. It turns the Linux distribution of your choice into an immutable, image-based system with Kubernetes built in. Bare metal, VMs, edge and public cloud, we have you covered!
This workshop is brought to you by our generous patron, [Spectro Cloud](https://www.spectrocloud.com/solutions/kairos-support).

virtualization.title: How will you run the VMs?

kairos-lab.md: kairos-lab creates and boots the VMs and sets up their network for you, so you can focus on Kairos.

own.md: You bring your own virtualization software. You must know how to create a VM, give it a network that is shared with your computer (or use tunneling), and make sure the VM can reach the internet. Stuck? Ask KAI for a TIP: a ready prompt you paste into your favorite AI assistant.

help.label: Not sure?
help.after: x86_64 means amd64. arm64 or aarch64 means arm64.

runtime.title: Which container runtime?
runtime.md: It is your choice, but Docker is the more battle-tested one for this workshop.

when.md: If you already have a runtime, `kairos-lab setup` uses it. If you have none, it asks before it installs one. Docker is the default. Run `kairos-lab setup -runtime podman` to use Podman.

windows.title: Windows: you play Master
windows.line: Not game over! You play MASTER.
windows.md: This is not game over. Zen is not available on Windows, so you play Master.
